plan.title: bug(session): cold/rearm session:start ceremony unbounded under many actives (finalize-owed inventory minutes)

narratives.Description: Cold and rearm session:start spend minutes in the finalize-owed inventory. discoverFinalizeOwed makes one serial gh api repos/<o>/<r>/issues/N call for each brief with a productPullRequest; on deftai/directive that is about 266 calls at about 0.85 s each, about 226 s of a 245 s median session:start, and it grows with every shipped story. This story replaces the per-issue reads with one paged open-issue list per run and keeps today's fail-closed outcomes and block rules unchanged.
narratives.Overview:
## Background

Cold/rearm session:start often spends ~2–3 minutes scanning finalize-owed (`#N unverified` × dozens) even with --defer-owed. Framework repos with 50+ actives make every leaf pay multi-minute tax. Related open: #5914 #5918.

## Environment

deftai/directive many active briefs; pin 0.129; sessions 01a16acd / 01a16f77.

## Proposal

1. Defer path O(1) or O(scoped to lane).
2. Full inventory only on explicit finalize.
3. Acceptance: session:start --defer-owed=<lane> returns interactively (<~15s typical) in a repo with 50+ actives; hang >2m is a defect.

## Forensic refs

`~/Projects/directive-failures/` PROPOSAL T-table + CATALOG-01a16acd + CATALOG-01a16f77 **T5**; catalog §3 ceremony; also session:start hang notes in 01a16f77
narratives.UserStory: As an agent starting a mutation session on a repo with many shipped stories, I want the finalize-owed inventory to read issue state in a few paged calls, so that session:start returns in seconds instead of minutes without weakening its fail-closed checks.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. packages/core/src/swarm/finalize-owed.ts: replace the per-issue fetchIssueState read with a first-demand, memoized lookup over one paged open-issue list (restIssueListOpenInventory: state=open, per_page=100, --paginate --slurp). An issue absent from a complete list is closed; open rows keep the protected staying-open label check.
2. A failed, empty or partial list makes every lookup return an error, so each item keeps today's issue-verify-failed outcome (unverified / unknown / stale-unverified); never closed or clean.
3. No change to which items block, to the claim probe, or to policy; the scan stays on the session:start hot path (#5171). The broader defer-path redesign in the issue Proposal is a separate design pass.
4. Tests in packages/core/src/swarm/finalize-owed.test.ts: stubbed list with open, closed and list-failure cases, plus a call-count assertion that no per-issue issue read runs; update existing per-issue stubs to the list endpoint.
5. One CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] line.
narratives.Constraint: Operator decision (2026-11-16): ship the issue-read speedup now; do not change block rules or policy in this story.
